summary: Live before/after in the real MM Pay Perps withdraw confirmation. Same screen, same $378 withdrawal, same $756.39 available balance, captured after a UI restart (the MV3-restart condition from the ticket). Before the fix the confirm button reads 'Insufficient funds' and is disabled while the screen simultaneously shows 'Available balance: $756.39'; after the fix the same flow is allowed. Only the hook differs between the two runs. A synthesized before/after card produced earlier in the session was fabricated evidence and has been deleted locally, removed from the artifacts repo (commit dedb61d3b4) and from the PR body; every artifact listed here is a real capture or a recorded run output.

before_after_pairs.label: MM Pay Perps withdraw confirmation: $378 against a $756.39 balance
before_after_pairs.note: Pre-fix hook (git show bc55c67781) vs post-fix, same $378 against $756.39 after a UI restart. Pre-fix hook (git show bc55c67781). Confirm button reads 'Insufficient funds' and is disabled; the fee and "You'll receive" rows are suppressed by ALERTS_HIDE_RESULTS, corroborating that a blocking alert is active. Captured at 4266 ms, when the display had already resolved to $756.39 and the alert was still blocking. Post-fix hook. Same amount and balance; confirm button reads 'Withdraw' and is enabled, with Transaction fee $0.72 and You'll receive $377.28 rendered. Published as fixes/45191/before-insufficient-funds.png and fixes/45191/after-withdraw-allowed.png.

standalone.label: Blocking alert at the empty-cache moment (970 ms after UI restart)
standalone.note: Pre-fix hook, captured while the displayed available balance was still $0.00 — the streamed cache emptied by the restart. Shows the alert firing at the moment the ticket describes, before the live subscription resolves.

standalone.label: Sampled DOM timelines for both runs
standalone.note: DOM sampled every 400 ms. before: insufficient=TRUE at 970 ms (avail $0.00) and still TRUE at 4266 ms (avail $756.39), clearing at ~9 s. after: insufficient never true; Withdraw enabled at 4988 ms. Related files: repro/after-fixed-timeline.json

standalone.label: Reproduction driver
standalone.note: Reloads the confirmation (UI restart), sets the amount to 378, samples the DOM and captures on state detection. Identical for both runs.

standalone.label: Hook-level A/B on live-captured account state
standalone.note: recipe-ab.json, 24/24 nodes passed. Records which balance source each hook version touched: pre-fix streamedCacheConsulted=true/freshReadCalled=false; post-fix the inverse. Related files: ab/prefix-observed.json, ab/postfix-observed.json, recipe-ab-run/summary.json

videos.note: No recording made for this reproduction; the transient is short and the sampled timelines plus the two captures at the decisive moments are the stronger artifact.
